item.title: TIBCO® Operated Control Plane AWS (EU region) - Authentication System Migration [resolved]
item.description: The migration of our account management platform from the legacy TIBCO Accounts to the enhanced PureAUTH authentication system has been completed successfully. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact customer support via the TIBCO® Support Portal at https://support.tibco.com.
